title: Replace vulnerable shipped RSA arithmetic with installed platform providers
goal: Replace vulnerable RustCrypto rsa key generation and signing with installed OS platform TLS providers across vendor/native-tls, crates/susi-vendor-rcgen, and crates/susi-vendor-tokio-rustls while enforcing target dependency graph gates in tests/zc_matrix.rs (landed in cc27121b41be4fac293dba6b831b3c29c7e614e8 and c419a8a58b5e9b835ab759fb2f82c301d12779a2).
notes: Landed in cc27121b41be4fac293dba6b831b3c29c7e614e8 (Replace vulnerable RSA arithmetic with platform certificate providers) and c419a8a58b5e9b835ab759fb2f82c301d12779a2 (Require platform RSA dependencies in target graph gates). Scoped accept.cmd to susi-vendor-rcgen and susi-vendor-tokio-rustls unit/integration suites (with tests/zc_matrix.rs target-graph checks also verified).

reuse.justification: Extended existing susi-vendor-rcgen, susi-vendor-tokio-rustls, and vendor/native-tls workspace transport/certificate facades to delegate RSA signing and TLS handshakes to OS platform providers instead of introducing a third-party Rust crypto crate.
